sources.content: Todd Camenisch leads Medical Science, Health and Management and teaches human biology, biomedical research, and hematology oncology, with expertise in microbiology and immunology.

sources.title: The Innate Immune System
sources.author: NCBI Bookshelf
sources.content: Innate immunity provides immediate defense through epithelial barriers, pattern-recognition receptors, phagocytic cells, complement, cytokines, and inflammation. Recognition of conserved microbial patterns initiates local responses that recruit effector cells and help activate adaptive immunity.
